tweet.text:
Woke up to $SELFIE at $50m

When it was at $2m, I threw $10k but still was waiting for a $1m dump to ape more

My thought was that $2m was already a good top for the actual market and its probably can run to $5m but no more

Today, my bag is worth $250k and I still haven’t sold a single token

Why did I flipped to omega-bullish?

Cause when the marketing is boring and a coin start doing it’s own run and doesn’t follow anyone else..

Consider it a winner, I now see $50m as a bottom.

Lesson learned.
